I would not recommend this groomer. She was rude and unpleasant to deal with from the start (very rude despite being respectful to her).
On top of that, my dog was injured during grooming — specifically his balls— which is completely unacceptable. Since that visit, he’s been anxious and clearly traumatized.

I regret ever bringing my dog here and will never return!

I am very satisfied with my dog's grooming. It was neatly trimmed where it needed to be, and we left with a shiny, silky, and nice-smelling coat. The groomer was gentle with the dog and me. ☺️❤️ I got an appointment right away when I called.
It was our first time at Liza's, and the end result was amazing! I can only recommend it!

Unfortunately, I didn't have a very good experience.

She completed the task, but her guest-oriented attitude could be improved. The communication was in a commanding, impolite, accusatory and downright hostile tone throughout. At the beginning, she sent me away from staying there, but later she contradictoryly asked me to stand by the dog, and then not to.

Unfortunately, our dog is afraid of the beautician, due to a previous negative experience. It would have been important for it to turn out differently this time. As someone else wrote before me, I also experienced that she would make a disparaging remark about the dog that she didn't like, instead of handling the situation professionally.

She may have just had a bad day that day, but the lady's manners could use some improvement!

Addition:

We had already indicated in advance that our dog would be afraid in such a situation by saying: we would like to stay by her side during the treatment, because we don't know how well she would handle it. We felt that this was not sympathetic to the beautician from the beginning, but in the end he still agreed to do the haircut. In my opinion, if someone feels that they do not have enough experience or comfort to handle a more timid dog, it would be worth indicating this clearly and correctly to the guest from the beginning, and then the guest can look for another place.

Our dog is obviously still being acclimated, otherwise I would not be able to formulate this assessment based on my own experience. :)

In addition, I did not find any prior information regarding payment methods that it is not possible to pay by credit card, neither on the website nor in the booking policy. He failed to inform us of this at the beginning, although this could be useful information for any guest.

I cannot recommend it wholeheartedly.
It was our first time at Liza's, she took all our needs into account and did a beautiful job! I can only recommend her🥰 …
